## Featured Infrastructure

### `religionmap.org`

[`religionmap.org`](https://religionmap.org/) maps places of worship worldwide for reproducible spatial and cultural analysis. Project code and workflows are available at [github.com/go-bayes/places-of-worship](https://github.com/go-bayes/places-of-worship).

## Complete Publication List

Joseph Bulbulia's complete publication record is maintained on [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5861-2056).
